title: clutia alaternoides f. grandifolia
intro: Clutia alaternoides f. grandifolia, commonly known as the large-leaved clutia, is a plant species in the Phyllanthaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Clutia alaternoides f. grandifolia include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant actions, which contribute to its healing and protective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
